description: Protect files using the current harness action.

hooks.command: repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && uv --directory "$repo_root" run --project .harness --quiet --no-sync python -m harness.hooks.codex_adapter --repo-root "$repo_root"
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$repoRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & uv --directory $repoRoot run --project .harness --quiet --no-sync python -m harness.hooks.codex_adapter --repo-root $repoRoot; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
